dimensions.description: Belief that the other person will act honestly, keep commitments, and avoid exploiting vulnerability.
dimensions.saturationRule: Positive gains diminish above 700; catastrophic memories can still move the value substantially.
dimensions.decayRule: Does not passively decay. Unused weak trust becomes described as untested rather than reduced.

dimensions.description: Recognition of skill, judgment, courage, integrity, or earned authority.
dimensions.saturationRule: Repeated trivial victories have sharply reduced impact.
dimensions.decayRule: Stable unless contradicted by later conduct.

dimensions.description: How well one person knows the other person’s habits, tells, limits, and everyday self.
dimensions.decayRule: Very slow descriptive staleness after years apart; stored history remains.
combatEffects: prediction of protective or fallback behavior

dimensions.description: Enjoyment, ease, and shared identity developed through work and ordinary life.
dimensions.saturationRule: Requires varied memories; repeating the same social event gives little gain.
dimensions.decayRule: Small decay only when relationship decay is enabled and contact is absent for long periods.

dimensions.description: Desire to test oneself against the other person. Rivalry may be constructive, tense, or hostile depending on Trust and Respect.
dimensions.saturationRule: Rivalry above 700 cannot grow from trivial contests.
dimensions.decayRule: May soften through reconciliation or diverging life paths.
combatEffects: risk of overextension when Trust is low

dimensions.description: Accumulated irritation, unresolved disagreement, or incompatible working habits.
dimensions.saturationRule: Minor annoyances cannot raise Friction above 500 without a continuing unresolved cause.
dimensions.decayRule: Can cool slowly if enabled, but the associated memories remain visible.
combatEffects: temporary Union refusal at extreme values

dimensions.description: Recognition of meaningful help, sacrifice, teaching, or care.
dimensions.saturationRule: Small favors cannot repeatedly produce large gains.
dimensions.decayRule: Does not decay automatically; may be reinterpreted by later events.

dimensions.description: Willingness to accept risk to prevent harm to the other person.
dimensions.saturationRule: Cannot grow from harmless Guard spam; only meaningful danger or sustained care counts.
dimensions.decayRule: Stable, but can be moderated through autonomy conversations.

dimensions.description: Fear of the other person’s behavior, power, judgment, or capacity to cause harm.
dimensions.saturationRule: Reassurance without changed conduct has little effect.
dimensions.decayRule: May reduce slowly with safe repeated contact if enabled.

dimensions.description: Connection formed by shared loss, memorial duty, or surviving the same tragedy.
dimensions.decayRule: Never passively decays; its meaning can change.

dimensions.description: Quality of the teaching relationship, including patience, authority, confidence, and willingness to learn.
dimensions.saturationRule: Cannot be raised by repeating effortless lessons.
dimensions.decayRule: Stable after graduation; may become collegial respect.

dimensions.description: Understanding of the other person’s cultural practices without claiming to represent or own their culture.
dimensions.saturationRule: One person cannot confer authority over an entire culture.
dimensions.decayRule: Knowledge remains, but trust in its use can change.

dimensions.description: Optional warmth or attraction. It never substitutes for Trust, Respect, friendship, or consent.
dimensions.saturationRule: No gain from gifts, currency, or repeated menu interactions.
dimensions.decayRule: Only through authored choices and settings; refusal of romance is not a penalty.
combatEffects: none directly; may qualify a consensual relationship event only

dimensions.description: Optional future-capable romantic interest requiring adult compatibility and explicit mutual consent.
dimensions.saturationRule: Cannot be raised by combat bonuses, paid items, gifts, or forced dialogue.
dimensions.decayRule: May be ended without punishment to either participant.

serializationRule: Store an edge only when at least one dimension is nonzero, an unresolved conflict exists, or a relationship memory references the pair.
romanceNeutrality: Friendship, professional respect, rivalry, mentorship, and family-like bonds are complete paths. Romance is never required and cannot be purchased.
